review_summary: QV-EDL-V02-015 dashboard trust/outcome projection is partially resolved: producer-authored trust_status is ignored, complete references render only REFERENCE_BOUND_UNVERIFIED, quarantine_reason is bounded to reason codes plus references, prediction_outcome is scalar/reference-minimized, malformed entity_id is rejected, and dashboard authority remains zero.

A new bounded dashboard integrity gap exists: prediction_outcome.autobiographical_experience_eligible is still accepted directly from the producer record and rendered when closure_id/closure_hash are merely present. The adapter explicitly does not validate canonical OutcomeClosure authority, registry freshness, revocation, provider identity, installation/workspace binding, or recompute closure_hash.

Therefore owner-visible UI can display autobiographical_experience_eligible=true from a self-consistent but unvalidated producer projection. This does not grant runtime authority, but it can falsely present a canonical memory-eligibility decision and must not be treated as promotion evidence.

Existing HIGH vetoes remain unchanged: Self-Origin still consumes producer-carried trust/anchor_alignment with only non-empty appraisal_binding_hash, and runtime-only pulses still call fixed per-update cognitive decay before runtime-domain early return.

ProtectedObject scope/origin remains bounded; Goal Ecology still has kernel-owned semantic dedupe, finite attention, opportunity cost, diversity reserve, satiation, fixation penalty and cooldown; append-only ledger live mode still requires external trusted anchor and bound workspace identity. These remain research candidates and provider/runtime integration is TEST_REQUIRED.

evidence: live_shadow_dashboard_event_adapter._project_prediction_outcome copies autobiographical_experience_eligible from the supplied prediction_outcome mapping after only boolean type validation.
The same adapter states closure_id plus closure_hash are only references and does not infer canonicality or validate provider/registry authority.
Current dashboard tests exercise autobiographical_experience_eligible=false as a scalar projection but do not adversarially supply forged true with valid-shaped unregistered closure references.
required_repair: Do not project autobiographical_experience_eligible as a boolean unless derived from a host-issued validated OutcomeClosure display receipt or independently validated canonical closure reference.
Without such validation, omit the field or render an explicit UNKNOWN_UNVERIFIED eligibility state; reference presence alone must never render true.

If a display receipt is introduced, bind issuer/provider identity, exact closure bytes/fingerprint, acceptance/registry freshness, installation/workspace identity, revocation state and projection policy hash.
Keep dashboard read-only: no drive/desire authority, no external action, no canonical Personality/Identity/Governance mutation.

closure hash mismatch after receipt issuance must fail closed
cross-installation validated-display receipt replay must fail closed
